macro_actions.name: Therapeutic Engagement and Relationship Building
macro_actions.description: Initiate and maintain a collaborative, empathetic, and trusting therapeutic alliance to foster open communication and engagement.

goal.objective: Establish a secure, collaborative foundation that enables effective CBT intervention.

success_levels.ideal: Patient feels understood, safe, motivated, and actively participates in setting therapy goals.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient shows some willingness to engage and participate with occasional reservations.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient is disconnected, mistrustful, resistant, or disengaged from therapy.

goal.reward_hint: Patient openly communicates, participates in goal setting, or verbalizes trust and engagement.

states: Patient expresses hesitancy, anxiety, or resistance
Therapeutic alliance requires building or repair
Rapport is low or therapy has stalled

macro_actions.name: Assessment and Collaborative Case Formulation
macro_actions.description: Gather presenting problems, symptoms, history, and collaboratively construct a CBT-based case formulation to guide treatment.

goal.objective: Develop an individualized, shared understanding of the patient’s difficulties using CBT principles to inform interventions.

success_levels.ideal: Therapist and patient co-create a precise, personalized formulation that guides therapy targets.
success_levels.acceptable: Basic cognitive, emotional, and behavioral patterns identified, working diagnosis established.
success_levels.unsuccessful: No clear or meaningful formulation is constructed; information remains fragmented or unclear.

goal.reward_hint: Therapist and patient refer to a case formulation and agree on intervention targets.

states: Progress stalls or revision is needed

macro_actions.name: Psychoeducation and Socialization to CBT
macro_actions.description: Educate patient about CBT principles, diagnosis, mechanisms, session structure, and treatment rationale to promote understanding and engagement.

goal.objective: Increase patient knowledge of CBT approach and their condition to foster engagement and motivation.

success_levels.ideal: Patient accurately understands and explains CBT concepts and therapy rationale, increasing motivation.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient shows basic understanding and openness toward CBT.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient misunderstands or rejects CBT, shows confusion or resistance.

goal.reward_hint: Patient asks informed questions, describes CBT concepts, or adheres to session structure.

states: Patient is new or unfamiliar with CBT
When introducing novel skills or interventions

macro_actions.name: Collaborative Goal Setting and Agenda Planning
macro_actions.description: Therapist and patient jointly identify goals, priorities, and set session agendas for structured, productive therapy.

goal.objective: Establish clear, mutually agreed treatment and session goals to guide interventions.

success_levels.ideal: Patient and therapist collaboratively set and review specific, attainable goals.
success_levels.acceptable: Goals are discussed and provide basic structure, though some priorities may be unclear.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Goals are vague, imposed, or absent; patient feels uninvolved.

goal.reward_hint: Patient takes an active role in selecting agenda items or verbalizes commitment to goals.

states: Patient desires change or wants to prioritize topics

macro_actions.name: Assessment and Mood Monitoring
macro_actions.description: Use ratings and structured inquiry to assess mood, emotional state, and psychological status as a basis for session focus.

goal.objective: Acquire current emotional and psychological state to guide intervention and monitor changes.

success_levels.ideal: Accurate information obtained and used to personalize session; patient feels heard.
success_levels.acceptable: Partial assessment completed, some insights gained.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Mood or psychological status not assessed, leading to inappropriate session focus.

goal.reward_hint: Patient reports mood openly, therapist conducts structured check-in.

macro_actions.name: Identification and Restructuring of Automatic Thoughts
macro_actions.description: Help patient identify, evaluate, and challenge automatic thoughts through CBT techniques such as thought records, Socratic questioning, and cognitive restructuring.

goal.objective: Reduce negative affect and maladaptive behavior by reshaping dysfunctional thought patterns.

success_levels.ideal: Patient reliably identifies automatic thoughts and independently modifies them, with symptom relief.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient sometimes identifies or challenges thoughts with therapist support.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient cannot identify or restructure automatic thoughts; symptoms persist.

goal.reward_hint: Patient shares thought records, participates in thought evaluation, and verbalizes new perspectives.

states: Patient reports strong emotions or problematic thoughts

macro_actions.name: Core Belief and Schema Identification and Modification
macro_actions.description: Uncover, evaluate, and collaboratively modify dysfunctional core beliefs or schemas; reinforce adaptive alternatives using cognitive and behavioral interventions.

goal.objective: Shift entrenched negative beliefs toward healthier, flexible alternatives to support lasting change.

success_levels.ideal: Patient identifies and systematically challenges core beliefs, adopting adaptive perspectives.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient becomes aware of core beliefs and practices alternatives with support.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Core beliefs remain unaddressed or unchanged.

goal.reward_hint: Patient discusses shifts in core beliefs and demonstrates change in behaviors or self-concept.

states: Persistent dysfunctional patterns traced to core beliefs
Patient expresses global judgments or meaning-making

macro_actions.name: Skills Training and Coping Strategy Development
macro_actions.description: Teach and rehearse adaptive coping skills such as problem-solving, relaxation, emotion regulation, assertiveness, and self-monitoring.

goal.objective: Expand patient’s repertoire of effective coping and self-management strategies.

success_levels.ideal: Patient masters skills and applies them with sustained benefit in real-life situations.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient learns and occasionally applies some skills with incremental gains.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient does not use taught skills, remaining dysregulated or unable to cope.

goal.reward_hint: Patient demonstrates fluency and reports skill use in session or real life.

states: Skill deficits or poor coping are present
Preparation for behavioral experiments or exposure

macro_actions.name: Behavioral Activation and Experimentation
macro_actions.description: Design and conduct behavioral experiments and activity scheduling to test beliefs, reduce avoidance, increase engagement, and support new learning.

goal.objective: Decrease avoidance, improve mood, and challenge dysfunctional cognitions through action-based learning.

success_levels.ideal: Patient completes experiments/activities, reflects on results, and revises beliefs/behaviors.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient attempts activities or experiments with partial engagement and learning.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient avoids or resists behavioral tasks; no learning or change occurs.

goal.reward_hint: Patient completes agreed activity/experiment and reflects constructively on the outcome.

states: Therapist introduces behavioral change or exposure
Patient is ready for practical, experiential learning
Mood is low or withdrawal is evident

macro_actions.name: Systematic Exposure and Response Prevention
macro_actions.description: Gradually expose patient to feared or avoided stimuli and prevent safety behaviors or rituals to reduce anxiety and avoidance.

goal.objective: Decrease anxiety, avoidance, and increase tolerance through repeated exposure and behavioral learning.

success_levels.ideal: Patient consistently completes exposures, reports anxiety reduction, eliminates avoidance.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient partially completes exposures with some progress.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient avoids exposure tasks or maintains high anxiety and avoidance.

goal.reward_hint: Patient reports approach behaviors and decreased anxiety following exposure work.

states: Anxiety, phobia, or OCD symptoms present
High avoidance or safety behaviors used

macro_actions.name: Identification and Modification of Maintenance Mechanisms
macro_actions.description: Guide patient to recognize and change coping strategies and behaviors that perpetuate psychological problems, targeting symptoms maintenance.

goal.objective: Break cycles of maladaptive coping and promote enduring behavioral or emotional change.

success_levels.ideal: Patient identifies and changes maintaining behaviors, resulting in symptom reduction.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient recognizes maintaining factors and begins experimenting with new responses.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient clings to old patterns; symptoms persist.

goal.reward_hint: Patient discusses minimizing maintaining behaviors and develops alternative coping strategies.

states: Maladaptive routine coping or behaviors present

macro_actions.name: Structured Problem Solving and Troubleshooting
macro_actions.description: Facilitate stepwise analysis and solution generation for current issues; adapt interventions collaboratively to overcome obstacles.

goal.objective: Enable effective resolution of present difficulties and adapt therapy to address barriers.

success_levels.ideal: Patient applies structured problem-solving independently and overcomes obstacles.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient engages in some steps, with incomplete resolution or progress.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient remains stuck or unwilling to engage in problem-solving.

goal.reward_hint: Patient generates solutions, evaluates options, and makes adaptive changes.

states: Patient is overwhelmed, stuck, or indecisive

macro_actions.name: Homework Assignment and Review
macro_actions.description: Set, monitor, and review homework tasks to promote skill generalization, self-monitoring, and progress between sessions.

goal.objective: Foster autonomy and reinforce skill use through active practice outside sessions.

success_levels.ideal: Patient consistently completes homework, reports insights, and demonstrates skill transfer.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient attempts homework with partial completion or engagement.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient avoids or disengages from homework; no skill generalization.

goal.reward_hint: Patient discusses homework results, brings in completed work, and applies skills in daily life.

states: End of session and between appointments

macro_actions.name: Review, Reflection, and Consolidation
macro_actions.description: Summarize key session points, elicit feedback, and consolidate gains and insights for continued progress.

goal.objective: Increase patient comprehension, reinforce learning, and strengthen engagement.

success_levels.ideal: Patient summarizes learnings, provides feedback, and applies insights to maintain gains.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient acknowledges summaries and feedback with minimal engagement.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Session ends without review, feedback, or patient understanding.

goal.reward_hint: Patient restates session takeaways, expresses satisfaction, or clarifies misunderstandings.

macro_actions.name: Crisis Management and Safety Planning
macro_actions.description: Assess risk of self-harm, severe distress, and address acute crises using safety planning and intervention strategies.

goal.objective: Ensure patient safety and immediate stabilization during high-risk situations.

success_levels.ideal: Risk managed, patient stabilized, and safety plan implemented.
success_levels.acceptable: Partial reduction of risk; ongoing monitoring and contingency plans established.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Risk persists; crisis remains unresolved.

goal.reward_hint: Patient engages in safety plan and crisis resources; risk is reduced.

states: Suicidal ideation or acute distress present

macro_actions.name: Involvement of Support Network
macro_actions.description: Coach and involve significant others, caregivers, or team members to appropriately support the patient in exposures or coping while promoting autonomy.

goal.objective: Enhance therapeutic progress and patient independence through constructive involvement of others.

success_levels.ideal: Support network provides appropriate encouragement, patient shifts toward independent coping.
success_levels.acceptable: Helpers are supportive but patient remains somewhat reliant.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Helpers reinforce avoidance, or patient remains dependent.

goal.reward_hint: Patient and helpers collaborate and patient progressively self-manages intervention tasks.

states: Support network involved in treatment or exposures

macro_actions.name: Medication Management and Transition Support
macro_actions.description: Educate patient on medication for psychological symptoms, coordinate with prescribers, and support safe reduction where indicated.

goal.objective: Ensure informed, safe use or withdrawal of medications while strengthening CBT skill reliance.

success_levels.ideal: Patient safely discontinues unneeded medications and manages symptoms with CBT skills.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient tapers medications with support, some withdrawal effects managed.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient unable to discontinue or manage medication effects; relapse occurs.

goal.reward_hint: Patient reduces medication use and increasingly relies on learned coping skills.

states: Coordination with psychiatric or medical providers

macro_actions.name: Attention Training and Mindfulness
macro_actions.description: Train patient in attention control and mindfulness practices to increase present-moment awareness, reduce distress, and improve emotional regulation.

goal.objective: Help patient manage internal distress and intrusive thoughts using mindfulness and focus exercises.

success_levels.ideal: Patient applies mindfulness skills independently and reports distress reduction.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient participates in attention exercises with partial benefit.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient avoids or misapplies mindfulness; distress continues.

goal.reward_hint: Patient reports practice of mindfulness, concentration exercises, or improved emotional state.

states: Internal distress or intrusive thoughts present
Therapist wants to shift attention or train skills

macro_actions.name: Acceptance and Self-Forgiveness Facilitation
macro_actions.description: Aid patient in accepting unchangeable situations or feelings and developing self-forgiveness to alleviate guilt and shame.

goal.objective: Reduce distress related to guilt or shame by fostering acceptance and compassion.

success_levels.ideal: Patient experiences non-judgmental acceptance and self-forgiveness, reducing distress.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient attempts acceptance or self-forgiveness with partial relief.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient remains stuck in guilt, shame, or distress.

goal.reward_hint: Patient verbalizes acceptance, completes reflection exercises, or shows reduced self-blame.

states: Distressing thoughts or situations are unchangeable
Patient is stuck after cognitive/behavioral attempts

macro_actions.name: Relapse Prevention and Future Planning
macro_actions.description: Consolidate gains, anticipate relapse risks, develop maintenance strategies, and equip patient for ongoing self-management beyond therapy.

goal.objective: Prepare patient to sustain progress, cope with setbacks, and apply skills independently post-therapy.

success_levels.ideal: Patient proactively uses relapse prevention plans and maintains gains autonomously.
success_levels.acceptable: Patient understands relapse risk and uses strategies with occasional support.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Patient is unprepared for relapse and regresses without recovery plan.

goal.reward_hint: Patient articulates maintenance plan, demonstrates readiness for independence, or reviews relapse prevention strategies.

states: Patient expresses concern about relapse or setbacks
Transitioning out of therapy or reducing session frequency

macro_actions.name: Therapist Competence Monitoring and Supervision
macro_actions.description: Therapist regularly reviews own CBT competence, engages in supervision and ongoing learning, and practices self-care to maintain quality.

goal.objective: Ensure therapist maintains effectiveness, ethical practice, and wellness for quality CBT.

success_levels.ideal: Therapist routinely engages in self-assessment, supervision, and education.
success_levels.acceptable: Therapist intermittently reviews skills and seeks feedback.
success_levels.unsuccessful: Therapist neglects competence or experiences burnout and declining quality.

goal.reward_hint: Therapist documents supervision, feedback, and continuing education activities.

states: Therapist is new or encounters complex cases
